## Summary

Describe the change and the user-facing behavior it affects.

## Verification

- [ ] `ruff check .`
- [ ] `pytest`
- [ ] `python -m build` when package metadata or release files changed

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests or docs were updated where appropriate.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` was updated for user-facing changes.
- [ ] Network-dependent tests are mocked and deterministic.
